title: should cancel only the chosen org's copy when the same trace_id runs in two orgs
verifies: cancelling one org's row for a shared trace_id sends exactly [{ trace_id, org_id }] for that org only

title: should send each selected row's org-scoped pair on bulk cancel
verifies: multi-select cancel emits each selected row's org-scoped {trace_id, org_id} pair and nothing else

title: should flatten a user's queries across orgs into org-scoped pairs on summary cancel
verifies: User Summary cancel flattens the user's per-query {trace_id, org_id} pairs across orgs into the cancel payload

title: should not fire a cancel request when the confirm dialog is dismissed
verifies: dismissing the confirm dialog closes it without issuing a cancel PUT
